title: Sacrifice is done away. | #iuic #israelunitedinchrist #nathanyel7
segments: Paul was writing the Israelites in
Galatia. You don't have to go back to
that. Christ came, he laid down his life
for you. You don't have to offer
sacrifices no more, which were the works
of the law, which was demanded under
Moses, under the old covenant under the
old covenant. Now he said we have mercy
and grace, the lamb of God, which takes
away the sins of the world. So now when
we sin, we don't have to go and offer up
an animal sacrifice because the time was
